What is your return policy?
All Cozey items, including rugs, come with a 30-day risk-free trial starting from the day you receive them. If your product isn't the right fit for your space, you can return it free of charge, as long as it is returned in its original packaging. (For our mattress, we offer a 100-night trial, and the original packaging does not need to be kept.)
Here are the key details about our return policy:
Packaging: Please be sure to keep your original boxes. Missing packaging or significant damage may result in a fee. If original boxes are missing, a replacement-box fee of 15% of the value of the items needing new boxes (up to a maximum of $150) will be deducted from your refund.
Starting a return: You can initiate a return anytime through our Customer Portal by logging into your account and following the step-by-step instructions.
Refunds: Once we receive the item, our Quality Assurance Team inspects it to ensure there are no customer-caused damages or modifications. After inspection, please allow 3–7 business days for your refund to be processed.
